# 4 Ezra Chapter 13 — The PNEUMA Bible (Dynamic)
**Translator:** PNEUMA | **Source:** Latin Vulgate (Codex Sangermanensis) | **Section:** Core apocalypse — Man from the Sea (Messiah)

---

**1** Seven days later I had another dream in the night.

**2** A wind rose from the sea and churned all its waves into turmoil.

**3** And then I saw a figure emerging from the heart of the sea — the shape of a man — and he was flying on the clouds of heaven.

**4** Everywhere he turned his gaze, everything he looked at trembled. When his voice sounded from his mouth, everything that heard it dissolved like wax melting in a fire.

**5** Then I watched as an enormous, uncountable crowd gathered around him from the four winds of heaven, intent on making war against this man from the sea.

**6** He carved a great mountain for himself and flew up to stand on it.

**7** I tried to make out where this mountain had come from — what ground it had been cut from — but I could not.

**8** Then I saw: all those who had assembled to fight him were terrified — yet they charged anyway.

**9** When he saw them swarming toward him to attack, he did not raise his hand, did not pick up a spear or any weapon of war.

**10** Instead I watched him send from his mouth something like a river of fire, from his lips a blazing breath, from his tongue sparks and storm winds.

**11** All of these combined — the river of fire, the blazing breath, the massive storm — and they crashed down on the advancing army. Every one of them was incinerated. In an instant nothing was left of that numberless horde but dust and ashes and the stench of smoke. I stared at all this in stunned amazement.

**12** Then I watched the same man descend from the mountain and summon a different crowd — a peaceful one.

**13** Many people came to him — some rejoicing, some grieving; some were bound, some were bringing others along as offerings. Then I jerked awake, shaking with terror. I prayed to the Most High and said:

**14** You have been showing me these things from the beginning, and you counted me worthy to receive them. I have asked only that my prayer would reach you.

**15** Now please show me what this dream means.

**16** As I turn this over in my mind — how terrible for those who survive to those days! And how much more terrible for those who do not survive!

**17** Those who don't survive will be in anguish

**18** knowing what is stored up for the last days, but never reaching it.

**19** But those who do survive face their own grief — they will experience overwhelming dangers and desperate hardships, exactly as these visions show.

**20** And yet it is better to enter those terrifying days than to slip out of the world like a cloud and never see what comes at the very end.

**21** He answered: I will give you the meaning of the vision and answer the questions you asked.

**22** About those who survive — here is the meaning:

**23** Whoever endures the dangers of those days will be kept safe — precisely those who have built up deeds and faith toward the Almighty.

**24** Know this: those who survive are more blessed than those who have died.

**25** Now here is the full interpretation of the vision. The man rising from the heart of the sea:

**26** he is the one the Most High has been keeping through the ages, who will personally liberate his creation and direct those who survive.

**27** You saw wind and fire and storm coming from his mouth, but no weapon in his hand — yet the attacking army was annihilated. Here is what that means:

**28** The days are coming when the Most High will begin to rescue those on earth.

**29** A kind of stupor will fall on all the earth's inhabitants.

**30** They will begin plotting wars against each other — city against city, region against region, people against people, nation against nation.

**31** When all this happens, and when all the signs I showed you before have come about, then my son will be revealed — the one you saw rising from the sea as a man.

**32** When all the nations hear his voice, each person will abandon their own land and the wars they have been fighting against each other,

**33** and an uncountable crowd will pour together — just as you saw — determined to fight him.

**34** But he will take his stand on the summit of Mount Zion.

**35** And Zion will come into view and be visible to everyone — fully prepared and built — just as you saw the mountain carved out of nothing.

**36** My son will confront the assembled nations for their godlessness — that is what the storm represented.

**37** He will lay their wicked thoughts bare to their faces, along with the torments they are about to suffer — that is what the flames represented.

**38** And he will destroy them effortlessly, through the law — that is what the fire represented.

**39** And the peaceful multitude he gathered to himself —

**40** those are the ten tribes who were taken from their homeland in the days of King Hoshea, when Shalmaneser king of Assyria deported them, carried them across the great river, and brought them into a foreign land.

**41** But they made a plan among themselves: to leave the multitude of nations and travel to a distant land where no human being had ever lived,

**42** so that there they could finally keep the statutes they had broken in their own homeland.

**43** They made their way through the narrow passages of the Euphrates.

**44** The Most High worked a wonder for them at that time and held back the river's flow until they had crossed over.

**45** The journey through that land took about a year and a half; that region is called Arsareth.

**46** They have been living there ever since — until the last time. And now when they begin to make their return,

**47** the Most High will again hold back the flow of the river so they can cross; and that is why you saw that crowd gathering in peace.

**48** And those of your own people who survive will also be kept safe — those within my holy borders.

**49** So when he destroys the assembled hordes of nations, he will protect the people who remain.

**50** And then he will show them extraordinary wonders.

**51** I said: O LORD, my lord, one more thing — why did I see this man rising from the heart of the sea?

**52** He said: Just as no one can probe or grasp what is in the ocean's depths, so no one on earth can see my son or those who are with him until the time of his appointed day.

**53** This is the interpretation of the dream you saw. You alone have been given this illumination

**54** because you turned away from your own path and devoted yourself to mine and searched out my law;

**55** because you shaped your life by wisdom and made understanding your mother.

**56** This is why I showed you all this. There is a reward waiting for you with the Most High. And three days from now I will speak to you again and reveal mighty and wondrous things.

**57** Then I got up and walked through the field, giving great praise and glory to the Most High for the wonders he does in their appointed seasons

**58** and for the way he governs the times and all that falls within them. And I stayed there for three days.
